Proposal: Four-Week Discovery Engagement

Scope (Four weeks of discovery only):
- current-state process map
- prioritized backlog
- implementation recommendation

Commercial Offer:
80 hours at $200/hour. Total $16,000. 50% at kickoff and 50% on delivery.

What we need from you:
Interview access and source documents. Start date agreed only after signature and named client contact.

Acceptance:
Sponsor confirms delivery of the three listed artifacts.

Exclusions:
Implementation, integrations, production support and guaranteed savings are excluded.

To proceed:
Sign and name client contact to agree start date.
